description: Under the base preset a server that holds the rri preset refuses what only the rri extension adds: a domain member of the extension is undeclared, and the request contact object is outside the preset (400 02001 like any content that does not conform to it, core RC4).
comment: Skipped on epp-docker: the EPP server offers no rri preset; the EPP config signals the preset by the RPP-Preset header; preset_signalling_header/ covers the header method.

steps.comment: Creates domain b2 with generalRequest, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base"; preset-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base"; preset-version="1.0"; expects 400 02001. An error answer this case checks.

Creates request contact RQ2 with uriTemplate, with Content-Type application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base"; preset-version="1.0", Accept application/rpp+json; preset="urn:ietf:params:rpp:preset:base"; preset-version="1.0"; expects 400 02001. The error answer this case checks.
